Integrated-mixture prior checked by numerical quadrature against generated samples; initial slopes remain private fixed Normals.
Mixed shared/separate reports and figures, scientific-target traces, fixed-dispersion convergence diagnostics and static-seasonality configurations checked.
Scheduler stubs verify probe gating, CPU plans and no compute-Python execution on the login node; missing environment setup fails before submission.
HPC screen/paper dry runs and local biobot dry run pass.
Python sources compile, login scripts parse with Python 3.9 grammar, and all 23 shell entry points pass bash -n.
